_notes: Gated DeltaNet (3 of 4 layers) + Gated Attention (every 4th layer) so
KV cache is small relative to a dense transformer.
Model card recommends tp=8 for the full 262k context; on a single A100
80GB we keep the card-recommended 128k floor for thinking quality (it
explicitly says 'maintain >=128K tokens') and bump gpu_memory_utilization
to 0.92 to absorb KV cache + activations on top of ~54GB of weights.
max_pixels=602112 (~776x776) caps each image at ~590 tokens; min_pixels
enforce_eager=true: torch.compile + CUDA-graph capture on this hybrid
arch added 5-15+ minutes of boot time with no perf win in our usage
(low concurrency, large weights bottleneck), so we skip them entirely.
